description: Land Title Settlement Department - Rajanganaya Yaya 15, Rajanganaya D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 11082
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Parcel of Land Nos. 30, 141, 59, 61, 69, and 70) with detailed information about land ownership, extent, boundaries, and encumbrances. The content falls under PART III - LANDS and involves land registration, ownership details, and property title determinations, which clearly fits the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
